title: Suitcase Relocation
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

successful_carousel_standard.rule: Build a public identity mirror with concrete couple receipts, active Zuv care, an emotional reversal, and a send/save thesis; stage the story in visible actions before choosing poster text; do not optimize for keywords.
successful_carousel_standard.open_reasoning_policy: Expose the real goal and selection logic; do not optimize for keywords or let slide copy substitute for staged story action.
successful_carousel_standard.prompt_rule: Prompts must prove relationship behavior through stage-scene Aachu/Zuv action; text completes the scene instead of carrying it.

human_truth: Some couples do not pack light; they overprepare together, create the suitcase mess together, and choose a harmless villain instead of blaming each other.
emotional_arc: relocate-the-house hook -> Aachu options proof -> Zuv real charger-mess proof -> shared suitcase wrestling -> forgotten toothbrush reversal -> zip-not-each-other bridge -> two-overpackers thesis
source_story_summary: Suitcase Relocation. Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house. She packed just options. He packed every charger except the one they needed. They sat on the suitcase. Still forgot toothbrushes. Nobody blamed each other. Only the zip. Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in the established Aachu/Zuv hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink carousel look. Identity reference images are the highest-priority face source: preserve the same recurring real-person faces, warm medium-brown South Asian skin tones, Aachu's expressive dark eyes and long dark wavy hair, and Zuv's curly dark hair, strong brows, dark almond eyes, defined nose, short natural stubble, and gentle smile. Previous successful carousel illustrations are style references only: use them for warm ivory paper texture, soft watercolor washes, fine ink and pencil linework, delicate sketch lines, gentle crosshatching, muted vintage palette, composition, wardrobe continuity, handwritten typography, and recurring props. Do not use style references as identity references. Keep the illustration premium, intimate, travel-light, emotionally soft, and story-first, with tactile clothing/prop detail, clean expressive faces, warm negative space, and one clear Aachu/Zuv behavior scene. The scene must be storyboard-first and stage-scene driven: action, reaction, eye-line, hands, body distance, object movement, silence, consequence, reversal, and payoff must be visible before text is considered. Text completes the scene; text must not carry the scene. Paper artifacts, receipts, labels, posters, or stationery can appear only as tiny integrated scene details, never as the main visual system. Render the exact slide copy as fixed handwritten-style dark charcoal text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

candidates.name: Blame The Zip, Not Each Other
candidates.universal_truth: Some couples do not pack light; they create the mess together and choose a harmless villain instead of blaming each other.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu packs 'just options' with full confidence because every possible version of the trip needs a look.
candidates.concrete_proof: The outfit pile, the cable pile with the needed charger missing, both sitting on the suitcase, forgotten toothbrushes, and the zip getting blamed.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv is equally guilty: he overprepares the tech pile, joins the suitcase wrestling, and stands with her against the zip instead of correcting her.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is shared ridiculousness without shame: blame the zip, not each other.

candidates.name: Two People Carry Their What-Ifs
candidates.universal_truth: Some couples overpack because they are really packing every tiny what-if.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu carries outfit options for moods, weather, photos, and emergency confidence.
candidates.concrete_proof: Multiple outfits, medicine pouch, extra scarf, charger mess, and the missing toothbrush reversal.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv makes room for her what-ifs while bringing his own, so the suitcase becomes mutual comfort instead of one-person chaos.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is making room for each other's just-in-case.

candidates.name: Packing Light Was A Lie
candidates.universal_truth: Every trip starts with 'we will pack light' and ends with a suitcase negotiation.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's options make the suitcase dramatic before the trip even starts.
candidates.concrete_proof: Outfit options, adapters, sitting on the bag, forgotten toothbrushes.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv participates in the lie and the negotiation instead of becoming the sensible outside observer.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is committing to the same little lie together.
